description: Search, read, and add to the objects saved in a mymind account, including notes, bookmarks, files, tags, spaces, and links.

fields.label: Access Key ID

fields.label: Access Key Secret
fields.description: The base64 secret shown beside that identifier. It signs each request locally and is never sent to mymind.

actions.name: search_objects
actions.description: Search a mind and return the matching objects with their relevance scores. Supports keyword syntax (quoted phrases, && || -, wildcards, and field filters such as tag:, type:, domain:, created:) and, with semantic enabled, matching by meaning rather than exact terms.

query.description: The search query, for example `tag:reading && action:read && completed:false` or `"design systems"`.

semantic.description: Whether to match by meaning rather than exact terms.

semanticBoost.description: A multiplier applied to semantic relevance when scoring.

similarTo.description: An object identifier to find similar content for. Setting it turns on semantic matching.

rerank.description: Whether to re-score matches with a cross-encoder for precision. Turns on semantic matching and caps results at 100.

inputSchema.description: The input for searching a mind.

semanticScore.description: The semantic relevance score, present for a semantic or reranked search.
